On Military Spending in the Budget Negotiations — to President Clinton, 16 April 1997

Congress of the United States
House of Representatives
April 16, 1997
William Jefferson Clinton
The White House
Washington, DC 20515
Dear Mr. President,
We wish to make clear our strong objections to any budget proposal which would maintain the current high level of military spending while reducing severely in real terms both discretionary spending on all non-military functions, and funding for Medicare and Medicaid.…
